title: Per-Developer Spec State (.spec/local.json)
description: Gitignored, one per checkout. Holds what differs between developers: where each code repo is checked out on this machine, and which change this developer is working in. Never shared state — anything a teammate needs belongs in .spec/project.json or a change manifest. spec-lint validates it when present.

repo_paths.description: Logical repo name (a key of .spec/project.json repos{}, used by areas[].code_repo) → absolute path of this developer's checkout. Read by spec-extract-audit, spec-record (stamp / changed / verify / equiv), spec-route, /spec-code-generate and /spec-code-verify. An area whose code_repo has no entry here cannot be audited or verified on this machine; the tools say so rather than guessing.

last_change.description: The active change: a slug of specs/changes/<slug>.change.json. Every spec command resolves against it when run without a target. Cleared (null or absent) when the change lands or is abandoned.
